institution: UNIR — Universidad Internacional de La Rioja
programme_name: Máster Universitario en Ingeniería de Software y Sistemas Informáticos
campus: No campus teaching — 100% online ("Modalidad: Online interactivo"). UNIR's registered seat is Avda. de la Paz 137, Logroño, La Rioja; RUCT records the title's CCAA as La Rioja.
official_status: máster universitario (OFFICIAL) — programme page header states «Título: Oficial»; RUCT 4315363, estado «Publicado en B.O.E. (TITULACIÓN RENOVADA POR ACREDITACIÓN INSTITUCIONAL)»
boe_order: Resolución de 18 de enero de 2022 de la UNIR, BOE núm. 24 de 28/01/2022, sec. III pág. 11770, ref. 1416 (publicación de la modificación del plan de estudios). Earlier BOE plan publication 23/02/2016; ANECA verification 11/03/2015.
eqf_level: EQF/EHEA level 7 (MECES 3 is referenced to EQF 7 in Spain's national referencing report)
europe_recognition: EHEA level 7 (Bologna) — academic recognition across the EHEA. This is an official Spanish Máster Universitario, ANECA-verified and inscribed in RUCT under code 4315363 at MECES level 3 = EQF/EHEA level 7, so it is a second-cycle Bologna degree that other EHEA countries recognise academically and that gives access to doctoral study. Two caveats that must not be glossed: (i) academic recognition is not professional recognition — a regulated profession still runs through Directive 2005/36/EC and the host country's own competent authority; (ii) recognition abroad still requires the receiving country's own procedure (a NARIC/ENIC statement or the receiving institution's assessment) — the EHEA makes it routine, not automatic.
modality: Online interactivo (100% online; «Exámenes: Online y/o presenciales» — final exams may be sat in person at a UNIR exam centre)
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND as an explicit statement — the programme page carries no «idioma de impartición» line. The page, the BOE plan de estudios and the official calendar PDF are wholly in Spanish and the title has no English name, but per the brief's rule 7 this is recorded as NOT FOUND rather than inferred.
start_month: February/March (spring cohort) — the current official calendar PDF is titled «Plan 2022 - Febrero 2026 (PER 14326)» and the page's «Convocatoria Actual» reads 16 mar 2026; the following advertised cohort is 2 nov 2026. No 2027 dates published yet.
notes: 60 ECTS (RUCT breakdown: 42 obligatorios + 0 optativos + 6 prácticas externas + 12 TFM), 1 academic year. RUCT «Nº Créditos Complementos Formativos: 0» — no bridging credits are built into the title itself (a university may still impose complementos on an individual applicant at admission). TUITION: UNIR publishes NO price for this or any master. The page's own FAQ «¿Cuánto cuesta el Máster en Ingeniería del Software?» answers: «Para conocer el precio del Máster en Ingeniería del Software online en UNIR deberás rellenar el formulario que encontrarás a la derecha de estas líneas. A la mayor brevedad, uno de nuestros asesores se pondrá en contacto contigo». The header block likewise shows «Consulta precios con tu asesor» in place of a figure. NOT FOUND is therefore the correct and final answer; no aggregator figure has been used. Because no price is published at all, no EU/non-EU differential can be confirmed either — UNIR is a private university and private universities normally charge one flat rate regardless of nationality, but that is NOT stated on this page and is recorded as NOT FOUND, not as "no surcharge". RUCT code confirmed independently of the input hint: the hint 4315363 matches the RUCT register row for the exact title and university. Practical note for a non-EU applicant: the title being official also makes it eligible in principle for public scholarship schemes and for the Spanish student-visa route, which a título propio is not.

campus: No campus teaching — 100% online («Modalidad: Online interactivo», «Clases 100% online» with live sessions recorded).
university_awarding: Universidad Internacional de La Rioja (UNIR) — but as UNIR's OWN certificate, not a state-issued degree
official_status: TÍTULO PROPIO — confirmed on the page itself, not inferred: the header block reads «Título: Propio». «Máster de Formación Permanente» is the post-RD 822/2021 legal name for a título propio. Admissions are handled by a separate address, admisiones.titulospropios@unir.net, and the page groups it under «Másteres Propios».
ruct_code: NONE — not in RUCT and not expected to be; títulos propios are not registered. Confirmed by RUCT query returning no such title for UNIR.
boe_order: NONE — a título propio has no BOE verification/plan-de-estudios publication. Its absence is definitional, not a gap in the research.
meces_level: NOT IN MECES — a título propio sits outside the Marco Español de Cualificaciones para la Educación Superior entirely.
eqf_level: NOT IN EQF — no MECES level means no referenced EQF level. The «60 ECTS» figure is the university's own credit count and does not by itself place the award in any qualifications framework.
europe_recognition: NOT recognised as a European second-cycle degree. This is the university's own certificate: it is not ANECA-verified, not in RUCT, not in MECES, and therefore not inside the EHEA/Bologna qualifications framework. It carries NO Diploma Supplement as of right and gives NO access to doctoral study in Spain or elsewhere. There is no automatic academic recognition in another European country — any recognition is at the sole discretion of the receiving university or employer, case by case. It may be well regarded by employers and it does carry 60 ECTS of the university's own credit, but nothing in that makes it legally equivalent to a Máster Universitario. It is also normally ineligible for Spanish public postgraduate scholarships, which matters for a funding-constrained applicant.
diploma_supplement: NO (not as of right — no statement of one on the page; a título propio is outside the regulated Diploma Supplement regime)
modality: Online interactivo (100% online, live classes recorded). Note: unlike UNIR's official masters this page shows no «Exámenes: Online y/o presenciales» row.
language_of_instruction: NOT FOUND as an explicit statement — no «idioma de impartición» line. The page, plan de estudios and calendar PDF are entirely in Spanish; recorded as NOT FOUND rather than inferred.
start_month: April (spring cohort) — the page's «Convocatoria Actual» reads 6 abr 2026; the header «Inicio» advertises the next cohort at 23 nov 2026. The currently published calendar PDF is the «Noviembre 2025 (PER 14117)» cohort. No 2027 dates published yet.
notes: 60 ECTS, 8 months' duration (shorter than the official masters' full academic year). Includes preparation for Microsoft AI-900 and DP-900 certifications, with the exam «incluido en el precio de la titulación». ENTRY: «debes contar con una titulación universitaria previa, la cual debe cumplir con los requisitos necesarios para acceder a programas de posgrado, ya sea esta nacional o internacional» — an international degree is explicitly accepted, and applicants without an official degree are steered to the «Programa Profesional» instead. TUITION: UNIR publishes no price for this programme; there is no figure anywhere on the page and the only route to one is an adviser. NOT FOUND is correct and final; no aggregator figure has been used, and no EU/non-EU differential can be confirmed. WHY THIS MATTERS FOR THIS CANDIDATE: UNIR sells this alongside the official Máster Universitario en Análisis y Visualización de Datos Masivos (RUCT 4315751) under near-identical marketing language, and the VA page explicitly offers this one as the fallback for applicants who fail its entry filter. The two are legally different awards. A Software Engineering graduate meets the official master's entry profile, so choosing this título propio would trade away EHEA recognition, PhD access and public-scholarship eligibility for no gain.
